log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 0 (quiet) to 4 (debug). Higher values increase log detail.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file used by the daemon for process management.

sample_rate.description: Default audio sample rate (Hz) applied to routes unless overridden.

echo_cancellation.description: Globally enable echo cancellation for all routes supporting it.

routes.description: List of named audio routing rules mapping inputs to outputs.

mute.description: Whether this route is muted by default.

delay_ms.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds applied to this route (for sync).

volume_control.description: Allow per-route volume adjustment via D-Bus or control API.

default_policy.description: Name of the routing policy to activate at startup.

policies.description: Named sets of route names to apply as presets.

items.description: List of route names in this policy.

usb_overrides.description: Override rules for specific USB audio devices based on vendor/product ID.

sink.description: Sink to use when this device is detected.

bt_sco.max_connections.description: Maximum simultaneous Bluetooth SCO connections allowed.
